MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The weatherproof Gorilla tape feels like a natural next choice because I have bought Gorilla tape before and used other supplies for hose and duct repairs.",
    "The epoxy fits my history of practical adhesive repairs, while the heat shrink tubing complements my earlier wire connectors by helping insulate wiring repairs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The cutting wheels, zero clearance tape and feeler gauge assume specific tools or tasks that my purchases do not establish a need for.",
    "The nuts and battery lugs require exact dimensions to be useful; my smaller wire connectors do not imply that I need large battery terminals.",
    "The cleaner and magnets could be useful someday, but I do not currently have a clear task that would make me choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seem to have been taken as a broad interest in workshop supplies, although I choose items for particular practical needs.",
    "Items involving wiring or tape seem to be treated as interchangeable, even when their size or intended use differs substantially from what I bought."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated Gorilla tape purchases are a stronger indication of what I would use than a loose connection to tools and maintenance.",
    "Compatibility and purpose matter: tubing that supports my earlier wiring repairs makes more sense than terminals for a different wire size.",
    "I need a recognizable repair use before choosing something; being potentially handy is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests but sometimes assume specialized project needs from loosely related purchases."
}
